HEIC decoder source distribution

The application uses libheif-js 1.23.5's bundled WASM build in a Blob Worker,
and the pure JavaScript build only when Worker/WASM is unavailable.
libheif and its libde265 HEVC decoder are LGPL-3.0.
All license texts are included in the source archives and in the generated
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. The original libheif-js package, including its
JavaScript factory and wrapper, is also included.
The Emscripten runtime license is included in EMSCRIPTEN-LICENSE.txt.

Pinned corresponding library sources:
  libheif-413e2a87.tar.gz:
    strukturag/libheif commit 413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00
  libde265-1.0.15.tar.gz:
    upstream release v1.0.15, used by libheif/build-emscripten.sh
  libheif-emscripten-1.23.5.tar.gz:
    catdad-experiments/libheif-emscripten tag v1.23.5
  libheif-js-1.23.5.tgz:
    unmodified published npm package

SHA-256 of library source archives:
  ef8e86a4e5670b7338a58b17553e306b8be88e506587b265dfdfe44495896999  libheif-413e2a87.tar.gz
  00251986c29d34d3af7117ed05874950c875dd9292d016be29d3b3762666511d  libde265-1.0.15.tar.gz
  8e3395ca983e369448bea84d223c35f1117373953e00219588415f1bc37c86ea  libheif-emscripten-1.23.5.tar.gz
  d0bfe7198bd624c524cef8ccf78e15ceb42683c87598c64c2e13ced0d8680932  libheif-js-1.23.5.tgz

Library rebuild (Linux build host, matching upstream workflow):
  Install Emscripten 3.1.61, CMake, autotools, Node.js, and TypeScript 5.
  Extract libheif source and libde265 source tarball to a build directory.
  Place libde265-1.0.15.tar.gz in the working directory so the upstream
  build script does not need to download it.
  Activate emsdk_env.sh and run:
    USE_WASM=0 USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0 USE_TYPESCRIPT=1 \
      /path/to/libheif-source/build-emscripten.sh /path/to/libheif-source
  Upstream build scripts, CI workflow and post.js bindings are in the archives.
  This application does not modify the generated decoder's algorithms.
  For the WASM decoder use the same sources and Emscripten version with:
    USE_WASM=1 USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0 USE_TYPESCRIPT=1 \
      /path/to/libheif-source/build-emscripten.sh /path/to/libheif-source
  The libheif-emscripten archive includes dist-prep.sh and its pinned CI
  workflow for both targets. The libheif-js package includes the WASM bundle.

Application rebuild / relink with a modified decoder:
  HEIC-SOURCES/application contains the application source, build scripts,
  package manifests, styles and license. Copy the contents to obsidian-pur/
  under a directory containing the supplied top-level LICENSE.
  Recreate third-party/heic-source from the files alongside this document.
  Run npm ci, replace node_modules/libheif-js/libheif/libheif.js with your
  modified pure-JavaScript factory if desired. For a modified WASM decoder,
  replace node_modules/libheif-js/libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js with your
  self-contained WASM factory. Run npm run build.
  build.mjs bundles src/heic-worker.ts, including the WASM binary, and embeds
  it into src/heic-worker-source.ts during the application build.
  No separately fetched worker script or .wasm asset is required at runtime.
  Worker/client/codec sources are included in HEIC-SOURCES/application/src.
  build.mjs forces only the browser environment branch; no HEIC data is
  converted or re-encoded for storage.
  Replace the generated main.js in your own plugin installation.
  No signing, installation keys or technical relinking restrictions exist.
  Reverse engineering for debugging library modifications is permitted.

Distribution:
  Keep HEIC-SOURCES/ together with main.js and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt when
  redistributing this combined work. It includes the corresponding library
  source archives and corresponding application source needed to relink.
  This is not a source-download offer: the archives are included offline.
  Application source retains its MIT license; the library retains LGPL-3.0.
  No warranty is provided. HEVC patent licensing may apply independently of
  copyright licenses; this project does not grant patent clearance.
